name: Front Row
summary: An event ticket card: pick seats on a venue map, then the stub flips over, prints and gets stamped
about: A ticket card for an open-air music night in Lahore, with a night-sky header where stars twinkle, string lights sway and a holographic sticker shifts colour as the ticket tilts toward your pointer. Pick a seating tier and quantity: the venue map lights the zone and drops a dot per seat while the PKR total counts to its new value. Get tickets scans the stub, flips it over to a printed ticket with a barcode that draws itself, then a PAID stamp thumps down with confetti.
how: Pick Lawn, Gold or Front Row (or tap a zone on the little venue map); the map lights up that zone.
Use minus and plus to set how many tickets you want; Front Row has only 4 left, so it stops there.
Press Get tickets: a light scans the stub, it flips over and the barcode, seats and gate are printed.
A PAID stamp lands with confetti; press Copy code to copy the ticket code, or Change to flip back.
Move your pointer over the ticket to tilt it and watch the holographic sticker change colour.
